name: @pipeworx/mcp-salesforce

tools.name: sf_query
tools.description: Query Salesforce records using SOQL. Returns matching records with all requested fields. Use sf_describe first to learn available fields for your object.

query.description: SOQL query (e.g., "SELECT Id, Name FROM Account LIMIT 10")

tools.name: sf_get_record
tools.description: Fetch a single Salesforce record by ID. Specify object type (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity') and record ID. Returns all fields.

tools.name: sf_search
tools.description: Search across Salesforce objects by keyword. Returns matching records from multiple object types like Accounts, Contacts, Leads. Use for broad keyword searches.

search.description: SOSL search (e.g., "FIND {Acme} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)")

tools.name: sf_describe
tools.description: Get schema details for a Salesforce object (e.g., 'Account'). Returns field names, types, relationships, and metadata. Use before querying to understand available fields.

tools.name: sf_list_objects
tools.description: List all SObject types available in your Salesforce org. Returns object names and labels. Use to discover queryable objects.

tools.name: sf_create_record
tools.description: Create a new Salesforce record. Specify object type (e.g., 'Contact') and field values. Returns the new record ID.

tools.name: sf_update_record
tools.description: Update an existing Salesforce record by ID. Specify object type and field values to change. Returns success status.

tools.name: sf_delete_record
tools.description: Delete a Salesforce record by ID. Specify object type and record ID. Returns success status.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-salesforce forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the salesforce pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
